title: Kingdom of Kongo
summary: Mbanza Kongo was a political and spiritual centre of the kingdom of Kongo. Its built environment reflects local institutions and later changes associated with Portuguese contact and Christianity.

claims.text: Mbanza Kongo was a political and spiritual centre of the kingdom of Kongo. Its built environment reflects local institutions and later changes associated with Portuguese contact and Christianity.
Broad fourteenth–nineteenth-century kingdom context; this does not assert continuous control over fixed borders.

The city makes it possible to examine institutions before and after overseas contact. Local traditions continued alongside change; European arrival should not be treated as the start of the region’s history.
